Changelog

This synthetic package records its maintenance changes here. Each heading identifies the release whose changes follow, so version and release date must remain attached to the corresponding content.

2.1.0 (March 2, 2024)

  • Add support for the latest Python release and document migration steps for existing users.
  • Fix a connection timeout when a remote service closes its socket during a streaming request.

2.0.0 (January 15, 2024)

This release removes an obsolete configuration argument. Applications should use the replacement setting described in the migration guide before upgrading their production deployments.

  • Preserve Unicode characters in error messages and keep public exception types stable.
